claim: The delivery is a restatement of the brief. There is no locale file and nothing was translated.

deliverable.content: Every checkout and email string in the brief is delivered. The strings are written in French. Prices use the French format, e.g. 12,50 €. Dates use the French long format, e.g. 7 octobre 2026. The supplied glossary terms are used. The copy reads naturally to a French shopper.
